en: The postcard features a sepia-toned historical photograph of a waterfront or dockside construction site. In the foreground, a group of workers are gathered, standing on muddy ground. Behind them, heavy wooden pilings and makeshift scaffolding make up part of a large retaining wall. In the background, various cranes, masts, and industrial buildings are visible, along with a few identifiable structures that suggest a busy port or shipyard. The overall atmosphere is industrial and early-modern.
